question.text: Complaints regarding non-repayment of deposits by Non-Banking Financial Companies (NBFCs) can be filed before which forum?

answer.text: Banking Ombudsman under the Integrated Ombudsman Scheme

explanation.text: The Logic: Complaints regarding non-repayment of deposits by Non-Banking Financial Companies (NBFCs) can be filed before the National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT). The Consumer forum is also mentioned in the source as an available forum for such disputes. The Trap: SAT hears appeals against SEBI, IRDAI, and PFRDA orders rather than NBFC deposit complaints, and SCORES is for securities-market complaints against listed companies and SEBI-registered intermediaries. The Banking Ombudsman may handle some NBFC service complaints such as credit-card matters, but it is not the cited forum for NBFC deposit non-repayment. Note: Source basis is p.381 and p.386 of the NISM-Series-X-A Investment Adviser (Level 1) workbook (June 2025), with NCLT and Consumer forum identified as the forums for NBFC deposit non-repayment disputes.
